card.name: Approximate time or degree qualifiers
card.fires_on: Small qualifying words that soften a time span or amount, such as late, almost, around, before, or of in 'greater part of'. They sit just before a date, age, or range in general prose.

modes.label: Time range words
modes.description: Words in the middle of an approximate period or age span, where a period or age is about to follow.

modes.label: Degree hedges
modes.description: Words like almost or somewhat that soften a statement just before the main claim.
modes.example: possessing in themselves<< almost>> no trace of personality.

card.plain: It fires on little hedging words like late, almost, or around that come just before a date, age, or amount.
